name: Mama Killa

domain_history.domain: goddess of the moon, marriage, and the menstrual cycle, "defender of women"; central to the lunar calendar used alongside the solar calendar for ritual timing; served by dedicated priestesses; represented as a silver disk (silver = her tears, as gold was Inti's domain/sweat)

notes: Genealogical relationship to Inti and to Manco Cápac/Mama Ocllo is inconsistently reported across sources (sister-and-wife of Inti and daughter of Viracocha in some tellings; parent of Manco Cápac and Mama Ocllo in others, conflicting with the more commonly cited version where Inti and Mama Killa are the parents) — flagged explicitly as unresolved variation across different chronicler traditions rather than adjudicated to one version. Associated with lunar-eclipse mythology: eclipses interpreted as an animal (mountain lion or serpent) attacking Mama Killa, with noise/gestures made to drive it off.
